newsitem.title: USA: Regal-Beloit to acquire Marathon Electric.
newsitem.headline: Regal-Beloit to acquire Marathon Electric.

text.p: Regal-Beloit Co on Thursday said it would pay $240 million in cash to acquire Marathon Electric Manufacturing Corp of Wausau, Wisconsin.
Marathon Electric is a privately owned manufacturer of electric motors, generators and related products, with revenues of $245 million in 1996.
Marathon Electric will continue to operate as a separate company once the deal closes, Regal-Beloit said.
Regal-Beloit is a worldwide supplier of power transmission equipment and perishable cutting tools.
Its shares were up 2 at 22-7/8 in early afternoon trading.
